messages:
Maya (People Ops): Quick manager heads-up: final reminder about reviewer handoffs and the form lock at 11:59pm PT. If you're delegating, please follow the transfer checklist and drop a note here.

Oliver: If I transfer 6 reviews to @Jen, will the submission timestamps inherit the new reviewer or keep original?

Maya (People Ops): They keep the original submission ts. The audit trail shows transfer with comment. Important: do not re-open closed forms.

Jen: I can take them. What's the recommended short handoff note format?

Maya (People Ops): Use: "TRANSFER: from @Oliver to @Jen; reason: load-balancing; outstanding: 2 comments". Paste it in the form comment and DM the original reviewer.

Kai: Small edgecase: one reviewer is on parental leave; manager already requested extension. Does transfer auto-approve extension?

Maya (People Ops): No. Extensions are separate. If an extension exists, transfer is fine but make sure the extension is logged in the approval sheet. No score changes allowed.

peopleops-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Forms lock in 4 hours" at 2026-04-01 06:00 UTC.

Oliver: Thanks. Also, do we need to flag transferred reviews for calibration sampling differently?

Maya (People Ops): Yes please tag transferred reviews with "transfer" so sampling script picks them up. If transfers >15% of a manager's pool, ping Ops for a quick mini-calibration.

Jen: Got it. I'll post a short note in the manager channel when done.

Maya (People Ops): Awesome 44d if anyone hits a weird permission or form bug during transfer, DM me and include a screenshot, we'll escalate to eng.

Oliver: Signing off to reassign now.

Jen: Done, transfer note added and DM sent.

Maya (People Ops): Thank you team :rocket:\"
